github-schema-20261027.graphql.gz
  GitHub's public GraphQL schema for github.com, gzip of
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/docs/c6f68e2527c324d52226d7de8bc49cf8e5c0e954/src/graphql/data/fpt/schema.docs.graphql
  (github/docs commit c6f68e2527c324d52226d7de8bc49cf8e5c0e954, "GraphQL schema update (#64431)", 2026-10-27).
  The same file docs.github.com serves at /public/fpt/schema.docs.graphql.
  github/docs licenses its code under MIT (LICENSE-CODE.github-docs) and its
  documentation under CC BY 4.0; this file is used for testing only, with
  this attribution. octokit/graphql-schema v15.26.1 (2025-11-24) was tried
  first; it defines EnterpriseOwnerInfo.repositoryDeployKeySetting twice and
  a GraphQL validator refuses it.
